Stiefel Congruence and Spectral Rectification Compress Condition Numbers While Preserving SPD Geometry

Dataloader / Protocol Diff: Paper loads pre-computed MATLAB .mat covariance descriptors on fixed random splits; spd-bench recomputes sample covariances from raw skeletal/radar/EEG windows with trace-scaled shrinkage (ε = 1e-4) for rank-deficient FPHA trials (T < 63). · Where It Struggles: Struggles on raw multi-channel EEG (BNCI2014-001 S2: 37.5%, S6: 43.1%) because SPDNet lacks temporal band-pass convolutions and Riemannian batch normalization.

Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

Paper loads pre-computed MATLAB .mat covariance descriptors on fixed random splits; spd-bench recomputes sample covariances from raw skeletal/radar/EEG windows with trace-scaled shrinkage (ε = 1e-4) for rank-deficient FPHA trials (T < 63).

Implementation & Optimizer Diff

Paper uses custom MATLAB Riemannian SGD with manual QR Stiefel retraction; spd_learn uses PyTorch orthogonal trivialization (Cayley/Householder) + AdamW/AMSGrad.

Where It Fails / Boundary Regime

Struggles on raw multi-channel EEG (BNCI2014-001 S2: 37.5%, S6: 43.1%) because SPDNet lacks temporal band-pass convolutions and Riemannian batch normalization.

Panel A (Structural) ✓ Verified (2 pts)

Stiefel Orthogonality Error, Post-ReEig Floor, and Tangent Dimension

Shows that BiMap(12, 8, parametrized=True) maintains Stiefel orthogonality error 3.78e-7, ReEig(threshold=1e-4) enforces minimum eigenvalue 0.0263 >= 1e-4, and LogEig(upper=True) produces exact tangent dimension 8*9/2 = 36.

Panel B (Signal) ! Falsified / Refuted (2 pts)

Condition Number Compression on Real HDM05 93×9393 \times 9393×93 Covariances

Tracks median condition number on 16 real 93×9393 \times 9393×93 skeletal covariance matrices from data/HDM05: raw covariances have median kappa = 6.92e5, which BiMap(93, 30) + ReEig(1e-4) compresses to 1.29e5 with 100% finite Loewner backward gradients.

Panel C (Analytical) ✓ Verified (2 pts)

spd-bench HDM05 (10 Seeds) & MOABB BNCI2014-001 Cross-Session Accuracy

Compares published HDM05 accuracy (61.60±1.3561.60 \pm 1.3561.60±1.35%) against our 10-seed spd-bench harness (63.10±1.5363.10 \pm 1.5363.10±1.53%, delta +1.50%) and real MOABB BNCI2014-001 Subject 3 cross-session accuracy (75.35% vs. 25.0% chance).

Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

NATO SET245 military X-band radar dataset is confidential (BLOCKED); on public Radar, HDM05, FPHA, AFEW, and BNCI2014-001, spd-bench uses standardized holdout and MOABB cross-session splits.

Implementation & Optimizer Diff

Paper runs 1-to-3 Karcher mean steps in custom Geoopt/PyTorch 0.4; spd_learn uses SPDBatchNormMeanVar with n_iter=3..5 and Exponential-map running mean updates.

Where It Fails / Boundary Regime

Single-step Karcher centering leaves a 0.18 Frobenius residual on high-condition-number (κ > 10410^{4}104) batches; requires n_iter ≥ 3 and fails under unadapted cross-session test shift.

Domain-Specific Momentum Batch Normalization Closes the Cross-Session EEG Transfer Gap by 8.33 Percentage Points

Dataloader / Protocol Diff: Paper uses custom NEMAR BIDS caching with dataset-specific channel picks (e.g., 20 sensorimotor ch on Lee2019, Fpz drop on Hinss2021) and evaluates transductive domain-specific batch statistics on the full test session; Stieger2021 has violin plots only (NO TARGET). · Where It Struggles: Fails in online single-trial BCI inference (batch size = 1) where target-session Fréchet mean cannot be estimated reliably, and on low-SNR BNCI2014-001 subjects S2 (46.2%) and S5 (56.6%).

3 · THE GAP & PIPELINE DIFFERENCES -1.15% mean Δ (5 NEMAR datasets)
Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

Paper uses custom NEMAR BIDS caching with dataset-specific channel picks (e.g., 20 sensorimotor ch on Lee2019, Fpz drop on Hinss2021) and evaluates transductive domain-specific batch statistics on the full test session; Stieger2021 has violin plots only (NO TARGET).

Implementation & Optimizer Diff

spd_learn implements DomainSPDBatchNorm (SPDDSMBN); standard inductive eval() mode freezes source-session running stats (-6.6% drop), whereas target-domain batch adaptation recovers the published 71.9%–80.6% accuracy.

Where It Fails / Boundary Regime

Fails in online single-trial BCI inference (batch size = 1) where target-session Fréchet mean cannot be estimated reliably, and on low-SNR BNCI2014-001 subjects S2 (46.2%) and S5 (56.6%).

Dataloader & Preprocessing Diff

Paper extracts dense overlapping multi-scale temporal windows with custom artifact filtering; spd-bench uses 6 non-overlapping temporal SPD tokens per 4s MOABB trial.

Implementation & Optimizer Diff

spd_learn implements Structure-Preserving Multi-Head Attention (SP-MHA) via triangular `tril_to_sym` re-projection so arbitrary head counts H preserve exact m = d(d+1)/2 tangent dimension.

Where It Struggles / Diverges

Applying 1D convolutions across sorted eigenvalues assumes adjacent eigenvalue indices remain aligned across trials, which can swap when two eigenvalues cross (coalescence).
